sources.snippet: A real-time, interactive Snake game powered by the Laya System 1 Decision Engine (cloned from NandhaKishorM/laya). The Snake uses Laya's non-autoregressive decision model to navigate the 20x20 grid, avoid hazards (walls and self-body collisions), calculate accessible flood-fill space, hunt apples ...
